shortDescription: create, update, or destroy Automation Platform Controller projects

options.name: allow_override
options.description: Allow changing the SCM branch or revision in a job template that uses this project.

options.name: controller_config_file
options.description: Path to the controller config file. If provided, the other locations for config files will not be considered.

options.name: controller_host
options.description: URL to your Automation Platform Controller instance. If value not set, will try environment variable C(CONTROLLER_HOST) and then config files If value not specified by any means, the value of C(127.0.0.1) will be used

options.name: controller_oauthtoken
options.description: The OAuth token to use. This value can be in one of two formats. A string which is the token itself. (i.e. bqV5txm97wqJqtkxlMkhQz0pKhRMMX) A dictionary structure as returned by the token module. If value not set, will try environment variable C(CONTROLLER_OAUTH_TOKEN) and then config files

options.name: controller_password
options.description: Password for your controller instance. If value not set, will try environment variable C(CONTROLLER_PASSWORD) and then config files

options.name: controller_username
options.description: Username for your controller instance. If value not set, will try environment variable C(CONTROLLER_USERNAME) and then config files

options.name: copy_from
options.description: Name or id to copy the project from. This will copy an existing project and change any parameters supplied. The new project name will be the one provided in the name parameter. The organization parameter is not used in this, to facilitate copy from one organization to another. Provide the id or use the lookup plugin to provide the id if multiple projects share the same name.

options.name: credential
options.description: Name, ID, or named URL of the credential to use with this SCM resource.

options.name: custom_virtualenv
options.description: Local absolute file path containing a custom Python virtualenv to use. Only compatible with older versions of AWX/Tower Deprecated, will be removed in the future

options.name: default_environment
options.description: Default Execution Environment name, ID, or named URL to use for jobs relating to the project.

options.name: description
options.description: Description to use for the project.

options.name: interval
options.description: The interval to request an update from the controller. Requires wait.

options.name: local_path
options.description: The server playbook directory for manual projects.

options.name: name
options.description: Name to use for the project.

options.name: new_name
options.description: Setting this option will change the existing name (looked up via the name field.

options.name: notification_templates_error
options.description: list of notifications to send on error

options.name: notification_templates_started
options.description: list of notifications to send on start

options.name: notification_templates_success
options.description: list of notifications to send on success

options.name: organization
options.description: Name, ID, or named URL of organization for the project.

options.name: request_timeout
options.description: Specify the timeout Ansible should use in requests to the controller host. Defaults to 10s, but this is handled by the shared module_utils code

options.name: scm_branch
options.description: The branch to use for the SCM resource.

options.name: scm_clean
options.description: Remove local modifications before updating.

options.name: scm_delete_on_update
options.description: Remove the repository completely before updating.

options.name: scm_refspec
options.description: The refspec to use for the SCM resource.

options.name: scm_track_submodules
options.description: Track submodules latest commit on specified branch.

options.name: scm_type
options.description: Type of SCM resource.

options.name: scm_update_cache_timeout
options.description: Cache Timeout to cache prior project syncs for a certain number of seconds. Only valid if scm_update_on_launch is to True, otherwise ignored.

options.name: scm_update_on_launch
options.description: Perform an update to the local repository before launching a job with this project.

options.name: scm_url
options.description: URL of SCM resource.

options.name: signature_validation_credential
options.description: Name, ID, or named URL of the credential to use for signature validation. If signature validation credential is provided, signature validation will be enabled.

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the resource.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The amount of time (in seconds) to run before the SCM Update is canceled. A value of 0 means no timeout. If waiting for the project to update this will abort after this amount of seconds

options.name: update_project
options.description: Force project to update after changes. Used in conjunction with wait, interval, and timeout.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to allow insecure connections to AWX. If C(no), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. If value not set, will try environment variable C(CONTROLLER_VERIFY_SSL) and then config files

options.name: wait
options.description: Provides option (True by default) to wait for completed project sync before returning Can assure playbook files are populated so that job templates that rely on the project may be successfully created
